message.content:
An editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. Centered is a large, white, sans-serif title: "TEMPO". Smaller text above and below includes "SIAPA BEKING RAJA SAWIT BUDIONO TAN", "MENKO POLHUKAM: KPK BUKAN DEWA", and "19-25 JANUARI 2015".

A man with tan skin and a dark mustache is shown from the chest up, viewed from the side and back. He wears a dark, peaked cap with a gold-colored emblem and brim. He is dressed in a light-grey short-sleeved uniform shirt with dark shoulder boards featuring gold-colored insignias. His body is turned away from the viewer, looking toward the right.

Integrated into the man’s lower back is a dark-grey metal safe. The rectangular safe door is swung open to the left, revealing a matching metal drawer pulled partially outward.

Large black text on the left reads "BUKAN SEMBARANG REKENING GENDUT". Below this, smaller yellow and black text states "Budi Gunawan ditengarai menggunakan dokumen palsu untuk menyamarkan hartanya." A barcode and price "RP 39.500" are in the lower-left corner.
